claims.claim_vi: The source lists nine monitoring aspects: data collection, data storage, data analysis, alerting, visualization, reporting and compliance, automation, integration, feedback loops, each with a one-line gloss, and says the cheat sheet compares the three major cloud providers and open-source / third-party tools.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Toy run: 1440 per-minute samples of a noisy metric (mean 50, sd 15) with two real incidents (mean 95) of 20 and 15 minutes, threshold 80. One sample over: 38 alerts, 32 false, both incidents caught with delay 2 and 0 minutes; three consecutive samples: 4 alerts, 0 false, delay 4 and 4; five consecutive: 3 alerts, 0 false, delay 6 and 6.
claims.verified_by: Run by the author on 2026-10-19 with a small Python program (seed 3); synthetic data.

design_notes_vi: Một khung năm bước theo đường đi của dữ liệu, một khung bốn ghi chú và một khung kết quả thử ngưỡng.
source_deviations: The source lists nine aspects with one-line glosses and a comparison table that exists only in the image; the lesson keeps the nine names and glosses, orders them by the path of data, and does not reproduce the table.
The threshold experiment uses synthetic data and is the author's addition.
The claim that false alarms erode trust in alerts is the author's inference, not from the source.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết tại repo này (gói W17), giữ ở trạng thái draft chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
